card.name: Just before a drug name's next piece
card.fires_on: Spots right before a drug name continues or is bracketed: an opening parenthesis after a generic drug name, the start of a split brand name (REBIF, PROGRAF), or 'of' before a hormone or drug.

modes.label: Parenthesis after drug name
modes.description: Opening bracket right after a generic drug name, where a brand or dose follows.

modes.label: Inside split brand or abbreviation
modes.description: A piece of a brand name or drug abbreviation that is split into parts.

modes.label: Of before a drug
modes.description: The word 'of' linking a dosing event to the drug that follows.
modes.example: before and after the administration<< of>> the exogenous hormone

card.writes: It seems to push toward endings and pieces of capitalized drug names, such as -OLA, -atical or -itic.
card.plain: It lights up at the point in a sentence where a drug's name or its bracketed brand name is about to continue.
